div.div: Protocols: MCP = agent ↔ tool / data (Anthropic, open). A2A = agent ↔ agent (Linux Foundation, open). watsonx Orchestrate supports both. Flow: solid = request lifecycle (L1→L5); dashed = cross-cutting telemetry (L6) & governance (L7).
